submission_checklist: A demo video (public on YouTube, under 3 minutes) showing the Lens working in Lens Studio preview.
A repository (GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket) containing the Lens Studio project files and the devpost/ folder in the root with your planning document.
A short description explaining what your Lens does, who it's for, and what you learned.
notes: This is Round 2 of Learn AR with SPECS.
No SPECS glasses are required; everything runs in Lens Studio's preview on your laptop.
Projects must be planned with the Devpost Learn skill pack and built with CLAD in Lens Studio.
